title: Memisis: Orchestrating and Evaluating Synthetic Data for Tabular Health Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the ratio of the highest to lowest group-wise False Positive Rate (FPR) across racial groups (e.g., Hispanic, White, Asian) in downstream classification tasks using a train-on-synthetic, test-on-real (TSTR) paradigm.
Evaluating false positive rate (FPR) disparities across gender/sex groups in downstream classification tasks using synthetic health data under a train-on-synthetic, test-on-real (TSTR) paradigm.
